providers.title: Packing in Euclidean space
providers.scope: Points of R^k in a closed ball of radius R with pairwise distances at least s number at most (1 + 2R/s)^k.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Euclidean subsets are doubling
providers.scope: Every subset of R^k is doubling with constant at most 5^k.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The doubling bound (OpenAI)
providers.scope: The set S of points over the plane with coloured-strip coordinates at scales 1000^-j is doubling with constant at most 76800.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Good points
providers.scope: A Lipschitz map of a plane domain into R^k is differentiable at almost every point, with both derivative columns approached in mean square on small squares.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Line integrals
providers.scope: On almost every horizontal (vertical) line, increments of a Lipschitz map are integrals of its partial derivative, with the Cauchy-Schwarz bound.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Near the lexicographic maximum
providers.scope: If the mean first coordinate of K-valued pairs tends to its maximum A, the limsup of the mean second coordinate is at most B.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Mean and variance
providers.scope: The mean square distance of a field from a vector a equals its mean squared length minus |a|^2 minus 2<a, mean - a>.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Two energy estimates (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Near a near-extremal good point, the row and column selections of the added sheets satisfy n^2 <|G_H^x - F_x|^2> -> 0 and <|G_V^y - F_y|^2> -> 0.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Lines with small energy
providers.scope: In a period block of small energy, one row line and one column line of each colour carry normalized offsets with oscillation at most N sqrt(2 N eps).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Crossings
providers.scope: The offsets at the crossings of the chosen lines give N points with pairwise distances at least sqrt 2 - 2 omega.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The Lang-Plaut problem (OpenAI)
providers.scope: S is a doubling subset of Hilbert space (constant at most 76800) with no bi-Lipschitz embedding into any R^k.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Finite-dimensional normed targets
providers.scope: S admits no bi-Lipschitz embedding into any finite-dimensional real normed space.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
